door3._note: P3.14 (PHASE_3_ADDENDUM.md) — Door 3 'trend leaders': ranks eligible names by universe-wide momentum (mean of universe_z(skip_12_1), universe_z(high_52w)); dedups against Door 1/2; no champion bonus.
door3._note_jump_share: P3.14b (orchestrator measurement 2026-09-24) — Door 3's first run picked PACS (one month = 90% of its 12-1 log gain, +177%) and IBRX (98%, +216%, only 5/11 months up): event jumps, not trends. jump_share = ln(1+largest single-month return)/ln(1+12-1 return); above this is not Door-3-eligible (reason jump_driven). Momentum research (Da, Gurun & Warachka 2014, 'frog in the pan') finds continuous gains persist and discrete jumps do not.

mid_cycle_window._note: Window by cluster from measured 10-year owner-cash-flow margin swing |3y mean - 10y mean| vs all-cluster median 0.041. 8 years ONLY for commodity-driven clusters above median: energy_upstream (0.061), energy_services (0.085), energy_midstream_refining (0.054), mat_metals_mining (0.068). NOT freight (0.036), chemicals (0.032), construction materials (0.020).
